title: Grinch Takeover Kids’ Club
seo_title: Grinch Takeover Kids' Club on Dec 2, 2026
description: Grinch Takeover Kids' Club is a holiday-themed event where children join the Grinch and his crew for festive fun at Kid's Adventure Club. It is aimed at young children, called "Little Whos" in the event summary. It takes place Wednesday, December 2, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM at the Kids' Nature Discovery Center at Fun Mountain.
venue: Kids’ Nature Discovery Center at Fun Mountain
